Medicine safety

Report a side effect

If you think one of our products has caused a side effect or another problem, please tell us. Every report helps keep medicines safe.

Is this an emergency?

If someone is seriously unwell, get medical help now. Go to the nearest hospital emergency department. Don’t wait for a reply from us.

What to report

  • Any unwanted or unexpected reaction after using one of our products
  • A product that didn’t work as expected
  • Damaged, discoloured or unusual packaging or contents
  • A product you think may be counterfeit

You don’t need to be sure the medicine caused the problem. Report it anyway.

What happens next

  1. We review your reportA member of our team will read it and may contact you for more details.
  2. We share it with the manufacturerWhere required, the report is passed to the manufacturer and the health authorities. Your contact details are kept confidential.
  3. We keep a recordReports help us and the manufacturer spot safety problems early.

Other ways to report

  • Phone To be confirmed

    +95 9 769 767 666

  • Email To be confirmed

    info@mmmpharma.com

You can also report side effects directly to the Department of Food and Drug Administration (FDA Myanmar).

Report form

About you

The medicine

The reaction
